facts.fact: a new Displace modifier: strength 1, mid_level 0.5, direction NORMAL, no texture
with no texture, Displace moves every vertex by (1 - mid_level) * strength along the normal
with a CLOUDS texture (bpy.data.textures.new(name, 'CLOUDS')), displacement = (value - mid_level) * strength
mid_level 0, strength 0.2: all displacement is outward, 0..0.2
direction 'Z' and texture_coords 'GLOBAL' are accepted (texture_coords: LOCAL, GLOBAL, OBJECT, UV)
an IMAGE texture (a ramp 0..1 along x) with UV coords displaces from about 0 to 1 across the grid
a new Shrinkwrap: wrap_method NEAREST_SURFACEPOINT, wrap_mode ON_SURFACE, offset 0

Shrinkwrap of a subdivided cube (size 3) onto a unit sphere: NEAREST_SURFACEPOINT, NEAREST_VERTEX and TARGET_PROJECT put every vertex on the target; PROJECT (no axis, both directions) casts along each vertex normal and leaves the vertices whose ray misses where they were
Shrinkwrap offset 0.1 keeps vertices 0.1 off the surface
